content: Phawuloosa Efesoona qiteeza
Aphiloosa Qoronttoosa yezin, Phawuloosa wookki bagga gader aadhii Efesoone helleeza. Ezayid pettii pettii ammaniza asita denggeeza.
Unttanakka, «Yi ammaneez wode Geesha Ayyana ekkeenee?» yeegii oyiceeza. Unttii, «wa77a, ekkekkaya; hara attozin, Geesha Ayyana yezanakka nu si7ekkaya» yeegeeza.
Phawuloosa unttiko, «Yeezin, yi abar xammaqintteenee?» yeegeeza. Unttii, «Nuunii Waannisa xinqqata xammaqintteeza» yeegii maheeza.
Phawuloosa, «Waannisa paapp guyer yi7iz Yesuusana asay ammanoday garkk asayis odittar, maarotithis beeziza xinqqata xammaqeeza» yeegeeza.
Unttii yeya si7ii Goda Yesuusa tamaarita maaqqodayis E sunthar xammaqintteeza gallas gallas Geeshsha Maxaafita nabbabiza.
Phawuloosa fa kusha unttal afa gaddin Geeshsha Ayyana unttal afa wodhdhin, duma duma doonar odintteeza; ma tinbbite odeeza.
Ye aqayid taphpho nam7e maaqqiz asitay yeza.
Phawuloosa Ayihude Woosa Keeth gelii, Xooss kaatetithii bagga yashittekkazar palamttarannee lo7ithii qonccisttar unttar hayidzii agina hellodayis gam7eeza.
Zin unttapp pettay pettay dhube maaqqii gaame asay tiina Goday oga cazhii ammanaam ixxeeza. Phawuloosa ammanizita unttapp shagii ekkii Xiranoosa giz timirtte keetha ubba wode unttan taamarsseeza.
Phawuloosa nam77ii layithi hellodayis qaala odeeza. Yey gishos, Iisiya yez as ubbay, Ayihuditayinnee Ayihude baazitay Goday qaala si7eeza.
Xoossay Phawuloosa kushe ootheez malatita
Xoossay Phawuloosa kushe wolqqama malabazita ootheeza.
Yey gishos, asay e galla bochcheez maarabe woy ma7o harggintteez asayis kanggiza. Unttikka paxiza; tuna ayyanitaykka unttapp keziza.

Tuna ayyanita kessittar yuuyiza Ayihuditaypp pettay pettay, «Phawuloosa sabbakiza Yesuusa sunthayir kezoytta gi yinttan azaziza» yeegii, tuna gaalenitay aykkeez asitayil afa Goda Yesuusa suntha xeegeeza
Ayihude Qeese halaqitaypp petta maaqqeez Asqeewa ginttiz athayis yeya oothiza laappun dhiirath na7itay yeza.
Zin tuna ayyanay unttiko, «Taanii Yesuusakka Phawuloosa baggakka eriza, zin yinttii oonanttara?» yeegeeza.
Tuna ayyana aykkeez athay unttal afa doonggii wodhdhii, unttal madoth kessii, ye karitipp kallo laasii dhabod hellodayis wolqqamii gameeza.
Efesoona yez Ayihuditayinnee Ayihude baazitay ubbay yeya si7ii iita yashitteeza. Goda Yesuusa sunthay gaame bonchintteeza.
Ammanizitaypp gaamitay fa ootheez iita oosa buuxittarannee qoncce odittar yi7iza.
Murunitaypp gaamitay fa maxaafita shiishii as ubbay tiina micheeza. Ye maxaafitay waagay waagay ishatam mukule bira
maaqqeeza.
Yey garkk hanii Xooss qaalay wolqqar diccittarannee dalggittar qiteeza.
Efesoone katama cabbotithi dendeeza
Yey polintteezapp guye Phawuloosa, «Taanii Yerusalaame maaqqii Oroome yhammadayis beeziza» yeegii Maqadoonarannee Akkayara aadhii Yerusalaame yhammadayis qofa acceeza.
Ma fana maaddizitaypp nam7ita Ximaatoosannee Erasxoosa Maqadoona kiittii, paas Iisiya xiqqa wode gam7eeza.
Ye wode yha ogay gishos iita kachchii kezeeza.
Pettii bira oothiz Dimexiroosa ginttiz athay Arxemisa eeqa kara misile birapp medhdhii gaame wodhe denggizazin.
Yey gishos, yey garkk ooso oothizita pettipp shiishii, «Asayyo, nu duretithay yha oosaypp maaqqeezana yi eriza.
Phawuloosa, yhay ‹As kushe oosintteezitay Xooss baaya› yeegii, Efesoonarannee xiqqa biittitaypp attin muume Iisa biitta ubbayil yez gaame asayis odii ammantheezannee maheeza yi be7eezannee si7eeza.
Meto maaqqeezay, nu oosay leqintteezita aadda baazin Iisannee gade ubbayil yez as goynniza gita Xoossinnee Arxemisa
Asay yeya si7ii shener kumii, «Efisoona Arxemisa bayira» yeegii uukkeeza.
Ye uufay katama ubba helleeza. Phawuloosa laggita Maqadoona asita, Gaayoosannee Arsxirokoosa unttar wolla dafi ekkii kaa7iza aqa woxxeeza.
Phawuloosakka asay shiiqeez aqo gelodayis koyeeza, zin ammaneezitay eza kayeeza.
Iisa biitta halaqitaypp Phawuloosas zhame maaqqeez pettay pettay Phawuloosako kiittii, «kaa7iza aqo qonccer kezii benttippe» gi eza woosseeza.
Shiiqeez asayis hanod baz dhabeeza; gaanggiza bagga asay hara attozin abis shiiqeezako erekkazay gishos pettay pettibaz gi uukkiza ma yhankkitay hara baz gi uukkiza.
Ayihuditay Iskkinddirose giz atha woya ganccepp tiina urqqeez, pettii pettii asay E godbaza odin Ezii asay si77i goday garkk fa kushayir mallii beezii, asayis mootinttodayis eqqeeza.
Zin Iskkinddire Ayihude as maaqqeez asay erii nam77ii saate maaqqod hollodayis ubbay pettii qaalar, «Efesoona Arxemisa damma» yeegii uukkeeza.
Wurssitha ye Katamitii xaafay woya si7ii udii, «Efesoona aso! Efesoona katamay gita Arxemiisas eeqa karannee salopp wodhdheez, gita shuchch naagiza maaqqeezana eroowa as oonoo?
Yhaya lahiza as baa maaqqiko yi si77ii godayisnnee ellisii 7iita baz oothopp naaginttodayis beeziza.
Yi yha asita, eeqa keeth miishe kasttekkazitannee nu Xoossita cazhii be7ekkazita ke7eeza.
Yey gishos, Dimexiroosannee ezar yez oosanchchitay oorakka mootintto koykko, pirdde keethi yeza; daynnitaykka yeza; u mootodayiskka danda7iza.
Zini yi hara oda koykko, Shanggo shiiqol oday bi7intto.
Yey maaqqaam ixxiko yhayino haneezibazayis Oroome kaatetithay nuna oyicoda. Yha buqithayis gaaso baa gishos nuunii malsse mahodayis danda7ooya»
yeegii shiiqa laaleeza.
